//go:build skipAuth

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"example.com/ci/yard/pkg/auth/staff"
	"github.com/impulseframework/impulse/accesstypes"
	"github.com/impulseframework/impulse/session/sessioninfo"
)

const (
	// googleInvited is the address the application's administrator invites, and
	// googleStranger another person of the same Workspace, whom nobody invited: under the
	// session library's skipAuth build tag every simulated Google sign-in is an account of
	// one Workspace, whoever signs in.
	googleInvited  = "ada@lakeside.example"
	googleStranger = "mallory@lakeside.example"

	// googleReturnURL is the page a sign-in through Google names, the application's root,
	// and googleCodeStep where the callback sends a browser whose sign-in Google admitted
	// and the second factor holds: the login page's code step, which goes on to the root.
	googleReturnURL = "/"
	googleCodeStep  = "/login?pending=mfa"
)

// googleLogin lets one sign-in through the simulated Google run at a time: under the
// session library's skipAuth build tag the callback takes the person from
// APP_<REGISTRATION>_USERNAME, which each round trip sets.
var googleLogin sync.Mutex

// TestInvitedThroughGoogle_seatedByInvitationAlone proves that in an application whose
// tenants have no directories the Google method is a way for an invited person to sign in
// and nothing more. The application's administrator invites an address into the tenant
// north with the role of a tenant's administrator. Another person of the same Workspace
// who signs in through Google with no link is refused as not invited: no account is made
// and the invitation stands. The invited person opens the link, signs in through Google
// and completes the second factor where the sign-in is held for it; they are seated in
// north with that role and nothing else, and the invitation is spent. No route of a
// tenant's directory is served to them: the application has none.
func TestInvitedThroughGoogle_seatedByInvitationAlone(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	ctx := t.Context()
	s := newServed(ctx, t)
	api := s.auth.Session().API()

	// The invitation, sent by the application's administrator into the tenant.
	admin := newBrowser(t, s)
	admin.signIn(ctx, adminUser)
	before := len(s.mail.Messages())
	invite, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"email": googleInvited, "name": "Ada", "domain": north, "roles": []string{"TenantAdministrator"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if status, body := admin.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/api/invite-staff-user", invite); status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("POST /api/invite-staff-user for %s in the tenant north: status %d: %s", googleInvited, status, body)
	}
	links := 0
	for _, m := range s.mail.Messages()[before:] {
		if strings.Contains(m.Text, "/login#invitation=") {
			links++
		}
	}
	if links != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the invitation mailed %d invitation link(s), want 1", links)
	}
	token := mailedToken(t, s, before, "invitation")

	// A person of the same Workspace with no link: refused as not invited, no account is
	// made, and the invitation stands.
	stranger := newBrowser(t, s)
	stranger.prime(ctx)
	if status, location := stranger.googleRoundTrip(ctx, googleStranger); status != http.StatusFound || location != "/login?code="+string(sessioninfo.RefusedNotInvited) {
		t.Errorf("a person of the same Workspace signing in through Google with no invitation: status %d to %q, want %d to the login page naming %s", status, location, http.StatusFound, sessioninfo.RefusedNotInvited)
	}
	users, err := api.Users(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("session.AuthAPI.Users() error = %v", err)
	}
	for _, user := range users {
		if user.Username == googleStranger {
			t.Errorf("an account was made for %s, whom nobody invited", googleStranger)
		}
	}
	if standing, err := api.Invitations(ctx); err != nil || len(standing) != 1 || standing[0].Email != googleInvited {
		t.Fatalf("the invitations that stand after the refused sign-in = %+v, %v, want the one for %s", standing, err, googleInvited)
	}

	// The invited person: the link, the sign-in through Google, and the second factor
	// where the sign-in is held for it.
	b := newBrowser(t, s)
	b.prime(ctx)
	if status, body := b.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/api/user/invitation", []byte(`{"token":"`+token+`"}`)); status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("POST /api/user/invitation as %s: status %d: %s", googleInvited, status, body)
	}
	switch status, location := b.googleRoundTrip(ctx, googleInvited); {
	case status == http.StatusFound && location == googleReturnURL:
	case status == http.StatusFound && location == googleCodeStep:
		b.secondFactor(ctx, googleInvited, false)
	default:
		t.Fatalf("the invited person's sign-in through Google: status %d to %q, want %d to %q or to the login page's code step %q", status, location, http.StatusFound, googleReturnURL, googleCodeStep)
	}
	if sess := b.session(ctx); !sess.Authenticated || sess.Username != googleInvited {
		t.Fatalf("the session after the invited person's sign-in = %+v, want authenticated as %s", sess, googleInvited)
	}
	if standing, err := api.Invitations(ctx); err != nil || len(standing) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("the invitations that stand after the acceptance = %+v, %v, want none", standing, err)
	}

	// Seated: the invited person reads the tenant's people, which the role grants in north,
	// and holds the role there and nothing for the whole application or in every tenant.
	if status, body := b.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/api/tenants/"+north+"/staff-tenant-users", nil); status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("GET the people of the tenant north as the invited person: status %d, want %d by the invitation's role: %s", status, http.StatusOK, body)
	}
	user, err := api.UserByEmail(ctx, googleInvited)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("session.AuthAPI.UserByEmail(%s) error = %v: the acceptance made no account", googleInvited, err)
	}
	held, err := s.access.UserManager().UserRoles(ctx, accesstypes.User(user.ID.String()))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("access.UserManager.UserRoles(%s) error = %v", googleInvited, err)
	}
	if got, want := held[accesstypes.DomainPolicyScope(north)], []accesstypes.Role{"TenantAdministrator"}; !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("the invited person's roles in the tenant north = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if got := held[accesstypes.GlobalPolicyScope()]; len(got) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("the invited person's roles for the whole application = %v, want none", got)
	}
	if got := held[accesstypes.EveryDomainPolicyScope()]; len(got) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("the invited person's roles in every tenant = %v, want none", got)
	}

	// No route of a tenant's directory: the application has no tenant directories, so it
	// serves none of them, to the tenant's own administrator either.
	for _, route := range []struct{ method, path string }{
		{http.MethodGet, "/api/tenants/" + north + "/tenant-directories"},
		{http.MethodPost, "/api/tenants/" + north + "/tenant-directories"},
		{http.MethodPost, "/api/tenants/" + north + "/open-tenant-to-directory"},
		{http.MethodPost, "/api/tenants/" + north + "/make-tenant-directory-only"},
		{http.MethodGet, "/api/tenants/" + north + "/sign-in-settings"},
	} {
		var body []byte
		if route.method == http.MethodPost {
			body = []byte(`{}`)
		}
		if status, answer := b.do(ctx, route.method, route.path, body); status != http.StatusNotFound {
			t.Errorf("%s %s as the tenant's administrator: status %d, want %d: the application has no tenant directories: %s", route.method, route.path, status, http.StatusNotFound, answer)
		}
	}
}

// googleRoundTrip sends the browser through the staff auth's Google registration as user:
// the login route, then the callback the simulated Google would send the browser to,
// whose status and destination it returns. The callback is asked for by its path: the
// served stack tells the registration no callback address.
func (b *browser) googleRoundTrip(ctx context.Context, user string) (status int, location string) {
	b.t.Helper()

	googleLogin.Lock()
	defer googleLogin.Unlock()
	if err := os.Setenv("APP_"+strings.ToUpper(staff.GoogleRegistration)+"_USERNAME", user); err != nil {
		b.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	login := "/api/user/" + staff.GoogleRegistration + "/login?returnUrl=" + url.QueryEscape(googleReturnURL)
	if status, _ := b.googleRedirect(ctx, login); status != http.StatusFound {
		b.t.Fatalf("GET %s: status %d, want %d to Google", login, status, http.StatusFound)
	}

	return b.googleRedirect(ctx, "/api/user/"+staff.GoogleRegistration+"/callback")
}

// googleRedirect issues one GET as this browser without following the redirect it
// answers with, and returns the status and where it points.
func (b *browser) googleRedirect(ctx context.Context, path string) (status int, location string) {
	b.t.Helper()

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, b.base+path, http.NoBody)
	if err != nil {
		b.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client := &http.Client{Jar: b.client.Jar, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error {
		return http.ErrUseLastResponse
	}}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		b.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body); err != nil {
		b.t.Fatal(err)
	}

	return resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("Location")
}
